text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Before we know it, it's already the final
day of
summer camp.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Well... I think that was a
productive
summer camp!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Because I was trying to go one-on-one
with a
bear!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
The final day of camp is the time to put
your progress to the test, right? So I
wanted to see
how much my power has
improved!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
But unfortunately, I wasn't able to find
any
bears...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I tried calling out to them, searching
through the
grass, pulling up tree roots...
But I couldn't find a
single one...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer? Why are you on the ground?
And why
do you look so pale?
choice_data_list: I'm so glad they weren't here...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
S-somebody call an ambulance! Don't
die on me,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I wasn't at risk of dying, but the thought
of Kawakami Princess fighting a bear was
far too horrifying. I tell her not to
attempt that ever
again.
